string.text: Near a lit campfire, each tick does one step: (1) temp on a random limb up to Temp fill, (2) convert limb temp to permanent up to 100%, (3) body temp up to Temp fill, (4) convert body temp to permanent. 0% Temp fill skips adding temp but still converts existing temp. Disable Campfire slowly regens life (arti).
How much temporary health the campfire will auto-apply (0-75). Permanent conversion always clears all available temp. 0 = convert only, no new temp.
Seconds between each heal tick (1-30). Lower = faster.
